conversation.text: We just bought a house and the previous owner had a system installed by you. Does the warranty transfer?
Partly.

Under the Warranty Policy, manufacturer parts warranties may transfer once to a subsequent homeowner, usually within 90 days of the home sale and subject to a manufacturer transfer fee of $50 to $100.
Meridian can provide the transfer form.
Meridian's own labor warranties do not transfer to a new homeowner.
Separately, the Comfort Club Maintenance Plan overview says memberships are tied to the service address and transfer to a new homeowner at the same address.

The Warranty Policy says that Comfort Club members at the time of installation receive a 5-year labor warranty instead of the standard 2 years, but it also says labor warranties do not transfer to a new homeowner.
It's 2987 Maple St, Hutto.
Hutto is within our service area.
The Service Area document lists Hutto under the Pflugerville / Hutto ZIP codes 78660 and 78634, and the Customer FAQ also names Hutto as serviced.
The Comfort Club Maintenance Plan overview says memberships are tied to the service address and transfer to a new homeowner at the same address, so a membership on that house stays with it.
